evals.name: table_formatting
evals.prompt:
Format this markdown table so it's readable:
| Name | Age |
|---|---|
| John | 25 |
evals.expected_output: A properly formatted markdown table with aligned columns

evals.name: line_break_fixing
evals.prompt:
Fix the line breaks in this markdown:
# Heading## Subheading
- Item 1
- Item 2
evals.expected_output: Markdown with proper blank lines between elements

evals.name: structure_formatting
evals.prompt:
Format this badly structured markdown:
```
# Title
Some text without proper spacing.

## Subtitle
More text here.
```

evals.name: check_mode
evals.description: Verify that check mode doesn't modify files
evals.command: echo '# Test' > /tmp/check_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py /tmp/check_test.md && test "$(cat /tmp/check_test.md)" = '# Test'

evals.name: write_mode
evals.command: echo '# Heading## Subheading' > /tmp/write_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --write /tmp/write_test.md && grep -q '## Subheading' /tmp/write_test.md

evals.name: dry_run_mode
evals.description: Verify that dry-run shows changes without modifying
evals.command:
printf '| A | B |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |
' > /tmp/dry_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --dry-run /tmp/dry_test.md 2>&1 | grep -q 'Changes for'

evals.name: technical_mode
evals.description: Verify technical mode suppresses line-length lint errors (MD013)
evals.command: printf '%s\n' '# Test' '' 'This is a paragraph with a reference link [like this](https://example.com) that should be fine.' '' 'Some text with inline code and more text.' '' '| Table | Data |' '|---|---|' '| cell | cell |' > /tmp/tech_test.md && ! python scripts/format_and_lint.py --technical --no-format /tmp/tech_test.md 2>&1 | grep -q 'MD013'

evals.name: fix_option_help
evals.description: Verify --fix help text mentions both Prettier and markdownlint

evals.name: fix_applies_both_fixes
evals.description: Verify --fix applies both Prettier formatting and markdownlint fixes
evals.command: printf '%s\n' '# Heading: with colon## Subheading' '' 'Some content.' > /tmp/fix_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --fix /tmp/fix_test.md && grep -q '## Subheading' /tmp/fix_test.md

evals.name: crlf_preservation
evals.description: Verify CRLF files keep their line endings AND their content through formatting (Windows regression test): 8 lines in, 8 lines out, and the table delimiter row still directly follows the header
evals.command:
printf '# Hello

| A | B |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 |

- Item 1
- Item 2
' > /tmp/crlf_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --write /tmp/crlf_test.md && xxd /tmp/crlf_test.md | grep -q '0d0a' && [ "$(wc -l < /tmp/crlf_test.md)" -eq 8 ] && [ "$(sed -n '4p' /tmp/crlf_test.md | cut -c1)" = '|' ]

evals.name: lf_preservation
evals.description: Verify LF files are not converted to CRLF and keep their content: 8 lines in, 8 lines out, and the table delimiter row still directly follows the header
evals.command:
printf '# Hello

| A | B |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 |

- Item 1
- Item 2
' > /tmp/lf_test.md && python scripts/format_and_lint.py --write /tmp/lf_test.md && ! xxd /tmp/lf_test.md | grep -q '0d0a' && [ "$(wc -l < /tmp/lf_test.md)" -eq 8 ] && [ "$(sed -n '4p' /tmp/lf_test.md | cut -c1)" = '|' ]
